name: proofpress
description: Typed knowledge infrastructure for continuous learning. Submit evidence-backed findings and retrieve eligible knowledge.

interface.shortDescription: Carry verified findings into the next agent task.
interface.longDescription: Proofpress connects agent-produced findings to evidence, dependencies, review history, and conditions for reuse. Submit bounded proposals and retrieve eligible knowledge from your assigned Hosted or self-hosted workspace. Human Approval remains outside the agent tool surface.
defaultPrompt: Initialize a Proofpress policy for this repository.
Retrieve eligible Proofpress governed context for this task.
Prepare a bounded evidence-backed claim proposal in Proofpress.
